intro: Albanian culture includes ancient polyphonic songs, strong codes of honour and a famous novelist.

chapters.title: Songs and stories
text: Albanian iso-polyphony, singing with several voice parts over a drone, is on UNESCO's heritage list. Ismail Kadare was one of Europe's most celebrated novelists.

chapters.title: Food
text: Byrek (filled pastry), tavë kosi (baked lamb with yoghurt) and fresh seafood are favourites.

keyTerms.meaning: Music with several independent melodies sung or played at once.
